headline: Build the dossier before the answer.
copy: Dossiers keep the source record more important than the generated explanation.

candidates.title: Steady action dossier
candidates.reason: Strong calm-action fit, clear source family, and safe reflection boundary.
candidates.packet:
Dossier: bg-2-48-steadiness
Meaning capsule: steady action without identity collapse.
Allowed use: calm reflection and carry action.
Boundary: not therapy, command, ritual instruction, or guaranteed peace.

record.title: Steady action
record.summary: Supports a calm reflection on steady action while keeping outcomes and personal identity separate.
record.boundary: Reflection support only; not therapy, medical advice, ritual instruction, or spiritual command.

candidates.title: Oppenheimer correction dossier

candidates.packet:
Dossier: bg-11-32-time
Meaning capsule: source correction before cultural context.

record.title: Oppenheimer source correction
record.summary: Corrects the common category confusion: the famous line is associated with the Gita, not the four Vedas.
record.boundary: Do not call it a direct quote from the four Vedas.
